1.consolidated_definition: tecnol. Instrumentos u operaciones que no involucran tecnología especializada. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. Formalmente, GUM se basa en combinar tres tipos de memes: uno visual, en el que imágenes famosas del imaginario de los mass-media es reconvertida mediante procesos low-tech, un sonido y una cita famosa convenientemente reconvertida (CREA PR, )
1.en_consolidated_definition: Technol. Instruments or operations that do not involve specialized technology. Raw anglicism, infrequently used. Formally, GUM is based on combining three types of memes: one visual, in which famous images from the mass-media imagination are reconverted through low-tech processes, a sound, and a famous quote conveniently reconverted (CREA PR).
